hardware.label: InSight lander
hardware.provenance: NASA MODEL (NASA 3D Resources: InSight Cruise Lander), native metres. SEIS, its Wind and Thermal Shield and HP3 are moved from the deck (where the model stows them) to the ground in front of the lander, in their deployed configuration: SEIS about 1.636 m away, about as far as the arm reaches (JPL, 19 Dec 2018), the shield placed over it, HP3 on the east side of the workspace (JPL). RECONSTRUCTED offsets: the 1.636 m is taken from the deck centre and HP3 is placed 1 m east of SEIS (not sourced); lander heading ASSUMED with the workspace (the arm side) to the south. Position: HiRISE-located lander (Golombek et al. 2020).
